_notes: Stage 0b of the main experiment, smoke test with the final prompts (EMIR 5 P2, task #93). Paid, NOT analysis data: reasoning texts are read for design flaws; any change is written as a dated amendment; its rows never enter the main analysis. 12 cards x 3 models x 1 group (10 rounds) + isolated arm 1 repetition (5 points) + rule comprehension. answer_format: the one stage 0a chose (placeholder until then). Run name main_s0b_<run day>, seed namespace pgg-main-s0b; separate from stage 1. Budget (proposal by the EMIR 3 rule, final with the prereg approval; workspace/main_dryrun_tablosu.md): budget_usd 10 >= the run's p95 upper bound, model_budget_usd >= each model's p95, expected_cost_gate_usd 5.5 >= mean x 1.1. Models (EMIR 5 K2): deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash pinned to deepinfra/fp8 (DeepInfra fp8), mistralai/mistral-large-4-0 pinned to mistral, openai/gpt-6-luna pinned to openai; allow_fallbacks false and require_parameters true for all three (pgg_game.provider_routing); temperature and reasoning_effort are not sent (logged "default"); max_tokens 16000; check_snapshot true (snapshot_version_models = [mistral], as in the mini-pilot). Frame abstract_v4 (EMIR 5 K1) = abstract_v3 + the line 'The following describes you:' before the card in the system message, locked by sha256 (frame_files); kind abstract (exempt from the frame linter). Cards: cards/main_cards_v1.json (EMIR 5 K3: Boston, Copenhagen, Athens, Riyadh x minimal / value / factual; minimal = v3, value = v2, factual = D2 C1 court-time card), locked by cards_sha256. comprehension true: the two rule-comprehension questions of the frame (key 28 / -6, neutral q2 ending); no exclusion, sensitivity only (EMIR 5 K6). Isolated arm: fixed_round, 'round 5 of 10' (isolated_round_no 5). answer_format: chosen by stage 0a (prereg_main P1); until then a placeholder (no real run starts). cost_calibration: the mini-pilot overlay (configs/cost_calibration_minipilot.json, sha256-locked) prices the dry run and the expected-cost gate; it changes no request. prereg_approved stays false until the user approves prereg_main.md: until then no real run (also --resume) starts; dry runs work. Paid runs are started from the user's own Terminal with scripts/runctl.py (EMIR 5 M3, README). Outputs go to runs_dir/<run>/ (outside the worktree).
